title: Rome's first emperor is four pictures from Tom Cruise
description: A Roman coin, a Hollywood epic and two White House photos connect Augustus to Tom Cruise.
hook: How is Augustus connected to Tom Cruise?

links.line: In 17 BC, Augustus minted this coin: his own head on one side, his adoptive father Julius Caesar on the other.
In the 1960 epic Spartacus, the young Julius Caesar was played by Hollywood actor John Gavin.

image.file: File:Nancy Reagan Visits Mexico City with Ambassador John Gavin After The Earthquake - DPLA - 5d1211646d7bc088f9908cfadc641730.jpg

links.line: Gavin later became Reagan's ambassador to Mexico, and guided Nancy Reagan through the 1985 earthquake ruins.

image.file: File:Nancy Reagan Photo Op. with Lab School Honorees Cher Tom Cruise Bruce Jenner Robert Rauchenberg in The State Dining Room - DPLA - 08ba0ffd80a1acb205f349e9ff6e9f60.jpg

links.line: Weeks later, Nancy hosted Tom Cruise at the White House, honored by a school for students with dyslexia.
